message.content: Someone hit our daemon's ingest endpoint from a random script last night. There was nothing stopping them.

Right, the daemon binds localhost but nothing authenticates requests. I'll add a bearer-token middleware: the daemon generates a token into ~/.lossless-claude/daemon.token on first start, and every route except the health check requires the Authorization header.
Do the hooks and the CLI read the same token file? They all talk to the daemon.
Yes — the middleware reads the token once at startup, and the CLI, hooks, and MCP server all send Authorization: ****** the file contents. Unauthenticated requests now get a 401.
